messages:
Nora (CS): Flagging an auth-related failure hitting a few onboarding customers' Dedicated pools during their eval runs. Symptoms: 401s on both embed and generate calls. Customers reporting: Ledgerlytics, FormFlow, DocuLane. I opened a triage with eng.
Ibrahim (CS): Oof. Any idea scope? Are these all in one region / pool type?
Priya (Eng Liaison): Quick note from runtime: secret-rotation job introduced a new KMS alias last night; a subset of pool controllers didn't pick up the rotated secret due to a rollout race. Triage ticket INF-7901.
SupportBot: Incident INF-7901 created by priya. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7901  status: investigating.
Nora (CS): Ok we need: 1) a 1-2 sentence customer status update for affected onboarders, 2) a tailored message for two accounts flagged as renewal-risk (Ledgerlytics & DocuLane) offering credit and priority eng time. Keep both short.
Ibrahim (CS): Draft for general affected: "Hi — we're investigating authentication failures (401) affecting Dedicated pools during onboarding. Engineers have identified a secret-rotation mismatch and are deploying a fix now. We'll follow up within 45 minutes with next steps and an interim workaround if needed. Sorry for the interruption." Thoughts?
Marta (AE): For renewal-risk, add empathy + concrete remediation: "We know this impacts your evaluation; we can provision an interim scoped key or rollback your prior key, and we'd like to offer a one-month credit and a dedicated session with our engineering team to assist your migration."
Theo (Onboarding): Workaround option: we can issue a scoped ephemeral API key. CLI: `rwctl keys create --scope pool:<POOL_ID> --ttl 3h --label temp-eval`. OpsDesk can DM keys.
OpsDesk: Confirmed  can create ephemeral keys and will DM CS leads after we receive pool IDs.
Priya (Eng Liaison): Patch rollout in progress: restarting pool controller replicas in batches to pick up latest secret. ETA ~302min. Will post when each pool is validated.
SupportBot: INF-7901 status: fix-deploying -> partial-recovery.
Nora (CS): Sending the general note now to Ledgerlytics, FormFlow, DocuLane. Tagging the renewal-risk customers for follow-up. Ibrahim please copy the messages to the CS comms folder after send.
Ibrahim (CS): Uploaded drafts: https://drive.redwood.com/cs/onboarding/1915432100-dedicated-auth-comms.md
Priya (Eng Liaison): Patch completed at 2026-03-22T09:14:20Z. Post-deploy checks: Ledgerlytics (pool-9a2) validated, FormFlow (pool-e7c) validated, DocuLane (pool-b4f) validated. Running 20m sampling.
SupportBot: INF-7901 resolved by priya. RCA note: race condition in secret-rotation rollout that left a small number of pool controllers with stale secret references. Action items: add rollout gating, increase monitoring for key-mismatch errors, and add clearer CS-facing incident template.
Nora (CS): I'll send RCA + apology + credit confirmation to the renewal-risk accounts. Also adding a 1-question feedback link: "Did this incident materially change your decision to proceed? Yes/No" so AE can quantify risk.
Marta (AE): Thanks. I'll record the credit in finance tracker and reach out if they request a legal amendment.
Theo (Onboarding): Note for postmortem: update onboarding checklist to include quick test after secret rotations. Filing follow-up in INF-7901.
Nora (CS): Closing loop here. If any customer replies indicate escalation, tag me and Marta. :handshake:
